questionText: If a reaction has a total collision frequency $Z = 10^{30}\text{ collisions L}^{-1}\text{ s}^{-1}$ and the Boltzmann factor $e^{-E_a/RT} = 10^{-6}$, assuming steric factor $P = 1$, the rate of effective collisions is:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Effective Collision Frequency Calculation (Chemical Kinetics):
Rate of effective collisions $= Z \cdot e^{-E_a/RT} = 10^{30} \times 10^{-6} = 10^{24}\text{ collisions L}^{-1}\text{ s}^{-1}$.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
